content:
The image shows a close-up of a plant surface completely covered with a dense, velvety gray-brown fuzzy mycelial/spore mass. Small dark specks are scattered throughout the surface, consistent with spore-bearing structures on dark stalks.

**Key visual features:**
- Dense, fluffy gray-brown spore mass covering the entire surface
- Velvety texture characteristic of Botrytis sporulation
- Small dark specks scattered throughout (black-stalked spore structures)
- Overall gray-brown coloration, not white (rules out Sclerotinia, Southern Blight, Powdery Mildew)

This matches **Gray_Mold** precisely: "Dense velvety gray-brown spore mass... fluffy gray spores cover infected plant parts... spores are light brown-gray on black stalks."
